ground_truth_method: hand-curated from transformers v4.57.3 source plus huggingface_hub.constants
ground_truth_reviewer_check: every entry has source.file + source.line; verify by opening the file at that line in the v4.57.3 tag

pretrained_model_name_or_path.description: Model id, local dir, or None (when state_dict + config supplied).

state_dict.description: Override of state_dict to use instead of loading from the checkpoint.

use_auth_token.description: Deprecated alias for token; raises FutureWarning. Raises if both token and use_auth_token are set.

_from_pipeline.description: Internal: pipeline source tag (added to user_agent telemetry).

_from_auto.description: Internal: signals call came from Auto* class.

dtype.description: Canonical name as of 4.57.x. Replaces torch_dtype.

torch_dtype.description: Deprecated; aliased to dtype with warning_once. If both supplied, dtype wins.

device_map.description: When string, must be one of auto/balanced/balanced_low_0/sequential OR a torch device spec. Int -> {'': N} on that GPU. Negative int raises. Requires accelerate.

load_in_8bit.description: Deprecated; raises if quantization_config is also set. Folded into a synthesised BitsAndBytesConfig with warning.

load_in_4bit.description: Deprecated; raises if quantization_config is also set. Folded into a synthesised BitsAndBytesConfig with warning.

_commit_hash.description: Internal: short-circuits hash resolution if known.

adapter_kwargs.description: PEFT adapter loader kwargs (LoRA / IA3 etc.). Empty dict by default.

generation_config.description: Override of the model's bundled generation config.

gguf_file.description: Path to a GGUF checkpoint. Mutually exclusive with quantization_config. Requires accelerate.

tp_plan.description: Tensor parallel plan. Only 'auto' is accepted as a non-null string. Mutually exclusive with device_map.

tp_size.description: Tensor parallel degree. Raises if set without tp_plan.

distributed_config.description: DistributedConfig instance. If set, forces tp_plan='auto'.

device_mesh.description: torch.distributed.DeviceMesh. If >1D must contain a 'tp' dim.

use_kernels.description: Opt-in path to HF kernel-hub attention kernels (flash via 'kernels-community/flash-attn' etc).

key_mapping.description: Optional state-dict key rename map; auto-applied for VLM classes when None.

low_cpu_mem_usage.description: Deprecated and silently popped (no-op) in 4.57.3. The kwarg is still accepted but has no effect; lazy-init is now always-on.

attn_implementation.description: Plus any registered ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS key; plus HF kernel-hub repo specs. Defaults to sdpa for torch>=2.1.1, else eager.

code_revision.description: Git revision for the trust_remote_code modeling repo (separate from `revision`).

watermarking_config.description: If dict, converted to WatermarkingConfig via .from_dict(). If a BaseWatermarkingConfig instance, kept as-is.

is_assistant.description: Hard-coded to False in __init__ (line 405); NOT user-tunable via kwargs.

low_memory.description: Deprecated; scheduled for removal in v4.62.0.

penalty_alpha.description: Deprecated (contrastive search trigger); scheduled for removal in v4.62.0.

dola_layers.description: Deprecated (DoLa trigger); scheduled for removal in v4.62.0.

diversity_penalty.description: Deprecated; scheduled for removal in v4.62.0.

num_beam_groups.description: Deprecated; scheduled for removal in v4.62.0.

TRANSFORMERS_CACHE.behavior: Override of resolved Hub cache directory. Emits FutureWarning when set.

HF_MODULES_CACHE.behavior: Where dynamic (trust_remote_code) module source files are cached.

HF_ENDPOINT.default_resolution: https://huggingface.co (or https://hub-ci.huggingface.co if HUGGINGFACE_CO_STAGING is truthy)
HF_ENDPOINT.behavior: Base URL for Hub API and file resolution.

HUGGINGFACE_CO_STAGING.behavior: If truthy (one of ENV_VARS_TRUE_VALUES), routes Hub calls to staging endpoint.

TRANSFORMERS_VERBOSITY.behavior: Override of default logger level. 'detail' enables INFO-level extra context. Unknown value logs an error and falls through to default.

TRANSFORMERS_IS_CI.behavior: If truthy, suppresses Hub telemetry user-agent enrichment.

TRUST_REMOTE_CODE.behavior: Legacy env var checked by RAG / RealmRetriever / TransfoXL tokenizer paths to short-circuit the trust_remote_code prompt. NOT used by the modern AutoClass.from_pretrained path (that uses the trust_remote_code kwarg directly).

HF_HOME.behavior: Root of HF cache hierarchy. Authoritative replacement for legacy TRANSFORMERS_CACHE.

HF_HUB_CACHE.behavior: Cache for snapshot downloads. Reads default via constants module.

HF_TOKEN.behavior: Bearer token for authenticated requests. Read by huggingface_hub when token kwarg is None.

HF_HUB_OFFLINE.behavior: If truthy, forces local_files_only=True; bound once at transformers.utils.hub import via _is_offline_mode. Setting after import has NO effect on transformers' is_offline_mode() helper.

TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE.behavior: Historically read by transformers; in 4.57.3 the actual gate is HF_HUB_OFFLINE on huggingface_hub. Setting TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE without HF_HUB_OFFLINE no longer forces offline mode in transformers itself.
TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE.ground_truth_note: Common LLEM-user misconception: TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE is widely set in pinned dockerfiles but is effectively a no-op in 4.57.3. HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 is the live switch.

HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE.behavior: Independent gate in `datasets`; not read by transformers core. Listed because mining-substrate users frequently set it alongside transformers config.
HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE.ground_truth_note: Out of transformers' control surface but documented because LLEM bundles datasets.

HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY.behavior: If True, transformers omits the X-User-Agent telemetry suffix.

HF_HUB_DISABLE_IMPLICIT_TOKEN.behavior: Disables automatic token resolution from cached login.

HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER.behavior: Opt-in to hf_transfer accelerated downloads; requires hf_transfer pkg.

XDG_CACHE_HOME.behavior: Base directory used when resolving HF_HOME and TORCH_HOME defaults.

WORLD_SIZE.behavior: If set and >0 while device_map='auto', logger.info warns about distributed-vs-auto interaction.

LOCAL_RANK.behavior: Required when tp_plan is set with explicit device_mesh; used to compute the local CUDA device.

task.description: One of ~30 pipeline keys; if None, infers from model.

processor.description: Multimodal processor; not in the existing schema baseline.

device_map.description: Same enum_for_string_form as PreTrainedModel.from_pretrained; mutually exclusive with device.

dtype.description: Default differs from model.from_pretrained: pipeline() defaults to 'auto', from_pretrained to None.

bnb_4bit_compute_dtype.description: Init signature default is None; __init__ resolves None to torch.float32. String form must be a valid torch dtype name.

exllama_config.description: If set, must contain 'version' key in {1, 2}.

hadamard_group_size.description: Resolves to 16 (nvfp4) or 32 (mxfp4) when None. Allowed sets differ per forward_dtype.

weight_block_size.description: Must be a tuple/list of length 2 with positive entries.

quant_method.description: Required key; values like 'fp8' or 'awq' route to legacy parser.
